props.gloss_en: R' Elazar: prayer is greater than good deeds
for there is none greater in good deeds than Moses our teacher, and nevertheless he was answered only through prayer
as it is said: 'speak no more to Me' (Deut 3:26), and juxtaposed to it: 'go up to the summit of the Pisgah' (Deut 3:27)
